title: Studio editorial
one_liner: Quiet, expensive founder look: a bold serif lead-in over a light sans line that types on as you speak, a warm grade, hard cuts between two framings and a soft music bed. Nothing bounces.
best_for: Opinion pieces, stories and 'here's what I've learned' talking heads where you want to look like an authority, not a meme page. Seated, calm delivery; 15-60 s.
effort: Medium. Film seated with your chest in shot and a lamp behind you; Claude cuts the pauses, times every caption word to your voice and builds the transparent caption overlay. You add the music in Edits.

palette.use: every caption word (no colour highlights, ever)
soft glow behind the captions at 45%, blur 24 px, so white reads over skin and hands
deepest shadows in the grade: soft, never pure black
skin target for the warm grade

pace: 1.0x speed, pauses trimmed tight, a hard cut every ~2.2 s (23.5 a minute) on phrase breaks, a new caption screen every ~1.6 s, the payoff line held to the last frame
signature_moves: Two-font caption: bold book-serif lead-in (1-4 words) over a light sans line whose words cut on exactly as they're spoken, white with a soft glow, at chest height
Two 'cameras' from one phone: full frame and a 1.18x punch-in, alternated with hard cuts on phrase breaks, never a transition or a creeping zoom
Ends on a payoff line: serif with the key words in italic and underlined, the only thing that animates (a short motion-blur slide), then the video just stops
